modes.name: bear_sway_armature
modes.basis: steel tube cantilever 16-25 mm OD, 0.9-1.3 m, tip mass 4-6 kg; f=(1/2pi)sqrt(3EI/(mL^3)-g/L) gives 1.2/2.6/6.3 Hz for a bare tube; x0.75 for joint/bolt compliance, low floored at 0.7 Hz (torso-pivot backlash). ASSUMED armature

modes.name: stack_rocking_on_cart
modes.basis: rigid bear+ball rocking on fixation springs: k_th=2*k*r^2 - m*g*h_cm (soft strap 5 kN/m .. hard cradle/bolts 150 kN/m at r=0.25-0.30 m); I=m_bear*h^2+m_ball*1.4R^2. RESTING ball: k_th<0 -> unstable, no mode

modes.name: eps_ball_flexure
modes.basis: EPS sphere (E=3-8 MPa) as short beam, k_th=EI/L with I at 60% radius, bear 9 kg at 0.85-1.1 m above ball top; ASSUMES solid EPS ball

modes.name: cart_bounce_vertical
modes.basis: 6 contacts, caster PU + carpet/pad in series 15-40 kN/m each; m = whole cart; f=(1/2pi)sqrt(sum k/m)

modes.name: cart_pitch_roll_on_casters
modes.basis: same springs, rotational: f_rot ~ 0.7-0.9 f_bounce for tall CoM on short wheelbase (ASSUMED)

modes.name: cart_horizontal_on_carpet
modes.basis: tyre sidewall + carpet pile shear 5-25 kN/m per contact, 6 contacts; stick-slip makes this nonlinear

modes.name: drivetrain_loaded_stepper_spring
modes.basis: rotor + cart mass (via r^2/G^2) on the stepper's magnetic spring k=T_h*50 (T_h=0.21 Nm at 1.25 A); excited by every start/stop and by step-loss chatter

modes.name: stepper_rotor_midband_resonance
modes.basis: rotor alone (wheel slipping / gearbox backlash open): f=(1/2pi)sqrt(k_m/J_rot); classic full-step resonance 100-300 Hz

modes.name: arm_cantilever
modes.basis: 6 mm steel rod 0.5 m, 0.25 kg eff. mass; EI=12.7 Nm2, k=3EI/L^3 (ASSUMED armature)

modes.name: head_on_neck
modes.basis: 1 kg head on short neck joint, k 0.4-2.5 kN/m (ASSUMED)

modes.name: torso_on_dance_pivot
modes.basis: torso 4 kg at 0.4 m above pivot restrained by dance gear train; backlash -> rattles at low amplitude (ASSUMED mechanism)

modes.name: caster_swivel_kinematic_trail
modes.basis: trailing caster yaw relaxes as f=V/(2*pi*e), V=0.0455 m/s, e=3-5 cm trail; heavily damped by swivel friction (zeta ASSUMED ~0.5, overdamped-ish); becomes flutter only above ~0.5-2 m/s

modes.name: caster_swivel_rattle_play
modes.basis: swivel bearing + axle play with lateral tyre stiffness 10-40 kN/m and caster+fork mass ~0.3 kg eff.; excited at reversals and by the 250 Hz buzz (ASSUMED)

modes.name: cart_pitch_load_transfer
modes.basis: cart pitching about the caster/rear-wheel contact springs when the jerk shifts dN=m*a*h/L between rear wheels and casters; same springs as cart bounce, tall stack adds inertia

excitations.name: segment_pattern_fundamental
excitations.note: 0.8 s on / 1 s pause / 0.8 s reverse / 1 s pause; velocity-step impulses -> flat comb up to ~1/t_rise; no ramp means every harmonic to >10 Hz has ~equal strength

excitations.name: start_stop_jerk
excitations.note: commanded: full speed in one step (4 ms); real: torque/traction-limited (mid masses); the stack sees a_real as a ~20-40 ms pulse plus drivetrain ringing

excitations.name: full_step_rate
excitations.note: 1.8 deg/step at motor, 0.18 mm/step at wheel; torque ripple through gearbox; audible buzz; loosens set screws

excitations.name: stepper_midband_overlap
excitations.note: 250 steps/s sits inside the rotor's own 170-330 Hz resonance band -> missed steps/chatter on a slipping or backlash-open drive

excitations.name: gearbox_mesh
excitations.note: planetary ring teeth x output speed (0.241 rev/s x ~40-56 teeth, ASSUMED tooth counts); planet pass ~0.7 Hz x3

excitations.name: reversal_backlash_impact
excitations.note: 2 direction reversals per 3.6 s cycle -> gearbox/hub backlash impacts, broadband

excitations.name: carpet_stick_slip
excitations.note: tyre creep/stick on carpet pile at 0.6 mu, 0.33 load share; broadband, depends on load share

excitations.name: caster_flip_at_reversal
excitations.note: front casters must swing ~180 deg at each reversal; needs ~pi*e/2 = 5-8 cm of travel but a segment is 0.1-3.4 cm -> casters end up sideways and SCRUB: lateral force ~39 N per caster, up to 1.8 m/s2 lateral kick on the cart, yaw moment, extra rolling resistance (traction margin eaten)

excitations.name: longitudinal_load_transfer

real.note: cart accelerating toward the rear (rear wheels push) adds dN to rear; accelerating toward casters or braking a forward run removes it

real_hi.note: cart accelerating toward the rear (rear wheels push) adds dN to rear; accelerating toward casters or braking a forward run removes it

tip_strapped.note: cart accelerating toward the rear (rear wheels push) adds dN to rear; accelerating toward casters or braking a forward run removes it

excitations.note: dN=m*a*h_cm/L (L=0.60 m wheelbase ASSUMED); rear wheels GAIN load when the cart accelerates rearward-pushing and LOSE it when braking a forward run or accelerating toward the casters -> asymmetric slip fwd vs rev -> net creep

excitations.name: try_me_dance_torso_sway
excitations.note: 'torso moves side-to-side on moving ball' (box text), 20 s cycle (MEASURED); sway rate ESTIMATED 0.4-1.5 Hz = inside bear sway band by design

forbidden_bands_note: 0.5-6 Hz: bear sway, torso pivot, stack rocking -> no periodic start/stop pattern with fundamental or strong harmonics here; ramp >= 1 s kills them
6-15 Hz: cart bounce/pitch + gearbox mesh; keep full-step pulse-train subharmonics and chatter out
15-40 Hz: loaded drivetrain mode; starts/stops ring here, avoid step rates 15-40 full steps/s
150-330 Hz: stepper rotor mid-band; current 250 full steps/s is INSIDE; fix with microstepping (1/8-1/16) or move to <100 or >400 full steps/s
cog_height_note: bear+ball stack CoM above the cart deck (mid masses); whole cart CoM above floor = 0.52 m

jerk_accel_ms2.note: commanded = 4.55 cm/s in one 4 ms step; realistic = torque-limited (at 250 steps/s .. first-step holding torque) or traction-limited, minus rolling resistance

real.note: cart accelerating toward the rear (rear wheels push) adds dN to rear; accelerating toward casters or braking a forward run removes it

real_hi.note: cart accelerating toward the rear (rear wheels push) adds dN to rear; accelerating toward casters or braking a forward run removes it

tip_strapped.note: cart accelerating toward the rear (rear wheels push) adds dN to rear; accelerating toward casters or braking a forward run removes it

caster.flip_completes: NO at 0.1-1.6 cm travel; MAYBE at 3.4 cm with 3 cm trail
caster.shimmy_flutter_threshold_ms: typ. 0.5-2 m/s for furniture casters (lateral tyre compliance + low swivel friction); at 0.045 m/s flutter is NOT expected

recommended_profile.note: keep every start/stop acceleration below 1/3 of tip_accel (strapped case 1.6 m/s2)
